module: Memory telemetry tracker: reports the machine's memory, the memory held by the game, and whether the OS has started paging to disk. It queries Engine.Platform.getMemoryInfo every 5 s. The "memoryPressure" event is only sent once per session, the first time low free memory and sustained paging are seen together. "memorySample" only exists if the server sets sampleIntervalSeconds (one-off survey).
notes: Pressure thresholds: available memory <= min(2 GiB, 10% of total physical memory) AND paging read+write >= 1 MiB/s.
The paging counters are those of the whole machine and include the file reads of any process: paging alone proves nothing, hence the combination with free memory.

sampleIntervalSeconds (config of the "memory" module) is clamped between 5 and 3600 s; without it, polling stops as soon as nothing more can be reported (pressure already sent, or paging not supported), the tracker then removes its onUpdate hook (M.onUpdate = nil then extensions.hookUpdate).
If the system does not provide paging counters, memory pressure cannot be detected (D-level log message).

The events notably contain physicalTotalBytes, physicalAvailableBytes, gamePhysicalUsedBytes, an estimate of the memory used outside the game, virtual memory, paging rates, the level and the paused flag (simulation paused).

onUpdate.desc: Hook called every frame: accumulates real time and triggers a read every 5 s. Dynamically removed when the tracker is done.

onExtensionLoaded.desc: Hook called on load: resets the state, reads sampleIntervalSeconds from the config, registers the onUpdate hook and switches to manual unload.
